description.narrative: Catalyst Fund Resilience I, L.P. (“Catalyst Fund” or the “Fund”) is an early-stage climate accelerator/venture builder sponsored by Bankable Frontier Associates, LLC (BFA Global or BFA) registered as a Delaware limited partnership. Catalyst Fund is a US$ 40m pre-seed high-impact fund backing tech startups that seek to improve the resilience of underserved and vulnerable communities in Africa, with a focus on fintech and climate adaptation solutions.

participating-org.narrative: UK - Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

activity-date.narrative: The Fund has a 10-year tenure (with +2 extension)
The transaction was closed and signed on 9th August 2023, and FSDAi made the first disbursement in October 2023.
